notes: Tirmidhi's remarks that Qatada and Abu Bishr did not hear from Habib but from Khalid b. Arfata (and that Qatada wrote to Habib) name other routes for the same saying: variant groups.
«وفي الباب عن سلمة بن المحبق» is a parallel report from another Companion, not a route of this saying; left out. «نحوه» is a wording note.
Juristic opinions and the Companions' rulings after the saying are not transmissions.
